title: The invoice pile
caption:
The invoice pile. Every stock manager's quiet enemy.

Supplier, invoice number, date, items, quantities, totals, typed by hand, line after line. And one typo is all it takes to throw off your records.

With Stacko, upload the invoice as a PDF, Excel file or photo. AI reads every line into a draft, flags anything new or unclear, and a person approves before anything is recorded.

Invoices in. Drafts out. You approve.
